description: Continue the autoflow of a story that is already in the document – no file needed: while the story overflows (Übersatz), add a page after the page of its last frame (same parent page) with a threaded frame of the size and frame options of the last frame, exactly as place_text_file with autoflow true does, until the text fits or max_pages (default 20, at most 2000) is reached. frame_id is any text frame of the story. A story that fits already is left as it is (pages_added [] and stopped "fits"). Returns frame_id, story_id, overset and autoflow {pages_added, frames_added[] {frame_id, page_id, bounds_mm, placement, frame_options_copied, frame_options_failed[], frame_options_skipped[], columns {count, gutter_mm}}, overset, stopped} – the same as place_text_file – and view_restored (keep_view, default true). A timed-out call may still have added pages – check list_pages before repeating. Stories managed by an editorial workflow (InCopy) that are not checked out here are refused before anything is written: invalid_state with details.code "story_locked".

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

keep_view.description: Restore the previous view (page and zoom of the layout window) afterwards – InDesign otherwise jumps to the new page. Default true; false lets the view move. The answer carries view_restored (null when the document has no window).

max_pages.description: At most this many pages. Default 20.

name: autoflow_story
title: Autoflow an existing story
